usageNotes: Use this endpoint to retrieve historical metric-collection performance data for a specific PDM remote, typically to assess polling health or response-time trends over time. Both `cf` and `timeframe` are required; choose `AVERAGE` for trend analysis and `MAX` to surface worst-case API response spikes. The only metric currently returned per data point is `metric-collection-response-time` (milliseconds), so this is most useful for diagnosing slow or degraded remote polling rather than guest-level metrics.

examples.summary: Fetch last hour of average metric-collection response times for remote 'pve-prod-01'

tips: If metric-collection-response-time values are consistently high (e.g., >2000ms), check network latency between PDM and the remote PVE node or consider increasing the polling interval.
Use timeframe=decade sparingly — RRD data is heavily consolidated at that resolution and may mask short-duration anomalies.
The remote `id` must match the identifier assigned in PDM (2–32 chars, alphanumeric/dot/dash/underscore); verify with the list-remotes endpoint if unsure.
